sources.note: October 9, 2026. Added to the Heritage legend at the owner's request; the church is not listed in Ordinance No. 2003-003 or the national registry. It keeps its church record, facts and site detail.

text.en: The parish in Concepcion Pequeña was established on December 8, 1964.
Its parish feast is celebrated on December 8.
Fr. Alfonso Grageda was the parish's first priest.
Fr. Mario Gaite built the church's Dome of the Twelve Apostles.
